title: The Zoomerbinis Project
description: This project, "The Zoomerbinis Project", offers Python-based solutions for efficiently managing Zoomerbini study groups

title: The Optimal Cleaner Robot
description: A C program that calculates the shortest path for a robot to clean all dirt on a 2D grid map using the Breadth-First Search (BFS) algorithm.

title: Data Parsing and Reporting Toolkit
description: A C-based application for efficiently processing, sorting, and summarizing structured data from Tab-Separated Values (TSV) files.

title: Elementary Cellular Automata Simulator
description: A C-implemented tool for simulating and analyzing elementary cellular automata, solving the density classification problem through algorithmic analysis.
